# @vllnt/convex-api-keys

> Secure API key management as a Convex component. Create, validate, revoke, rotate, and track usage with owner-scoped admin APIs, server-side secret generation, and structured audit logging.

`@vllnt/convex-api-keys` is a publishable Convex component for multi-tenant API key management. Keys are stored as SHA-256 hashes, looked up by prefix, and never persisted in raw form. Requires `convex@^1.45.0` (releases before 0.3.0 targeted `convex@^1.36.1`) and uses `@convex-dev/sharded-counter` for per-key usage counts.

For coding agents: this file, the API reference and the changelog are bundled in the npm package at `node_modules/@vllnt/convex-api-keys/`, next to the source in `src/`. They match the installed version. Read them before writing code against this package.
